_what: Inventory of every committed closed-loop artifact: which statistic produced it, whether the raw per-window data survives, and what was done.
_evidence_class: MEASURED (estimator strings read from the artifacts themselves; recomputations run on tanitad-eval)
_structural_finding: closedloop.run_and_save never persisted the per-window paths. collect() builds closed_bike/closed_grnd/open_grnd/open_bike/cv/gt as [N,4,2] and analyze() reduces to scalars; only the scalars were written. windows_<arm>.pt exists for the OPEN-loop panel only. So no closed-loop artifact could be corrected by arithmetic - the loop had to be re-driven on GPU. Every re-run here now persists clwin_<arm>.pt / p2win_<arm>.pt.
